scopeLimited: You see only the rentals sites in your access. Lists and totals cover those sites; nothing is said about the others.
d33: Issuing model: a labelled fictional alternative until a legal and tax adviser rules (decision D-33). No legal or tax validity is claimed.

boundary.title: Contract, demand, money, deposit and instruction never mix
boundary.short: A lease is a contract; an approved rent roll is a demand, not an invoice; nothing is settled without bank evidence; deposits belong to tenants; a payout instruction moves no money.
boundary.lease: A lease is a contract and its rent schedule: what the tenant owes, version by version.
boundary.roll: An approved rent roll is a demand schedule. It is not an invoice: posting to invoices is not connected yet.
boundary.money: Collected rent and bank-settled cash need independent bank evidence. None exists here, so nothing is settled and the owner payable stays 0.00.
boundary.deposit: A deposit is a liability held for the tenant: never owner income and never paid out to the owner.
boundary.payout: A payout instruction, even approved, is not sent and not paid. It changes neither cash nor the owner payable.

model.principalHint: The owner’s own client legal entity issues, into the owner’s own verified account; the manager holds none of the owner’s money (fictional alternative).

lease.title: Lease {{ref}}

effect.submit: Someone else who may manage leases then activates it, once every blocker is resolved. You cannot activate a lease you drafted or submitted.
effect.activate: The lease becomes active and gets its own payer account (kind lease). Rent is scheduled from its start date; nothing is invoiced or collected by this step.
effect.cancel: The draft is kept in the unit’s history as cancelled. Nothing else changes.

done.renew: Lease {{ref}} renewed as a new version

lease.ownDraft: You drafted or submitted this lease, so another person who may manage leases must activate it.
lease.blockersTitle: This lease cannot be activated yet
lease.unitNone: No other lease of this unit.
lease.payerAccountNone: Created when the lease is activated
lease.duesSeparate: Rent has its own payer account (kind lease). The society maintenance dues account and its payer are separate and unchanged.
lease.issuingNone: No issuing model until every landlord has an agreement.
lease.issuingTitle: Who issues and where the money goes
lease.scheduleHint: One line a month on the due day, by lease version. No pro rating (a fictional demo rule). A line in an approved rent roll is a demand, not an invoice.
lease.scheduleNoneHint: The schedule starts when the lease is active.
lease.invoicesTitle: No invoices or payments: posting is not connected (partial)
lease.invoicesBody: The shared invoice engine has no lease billing subject yet, so rent is never posted as an invoice here. No payment, receipt or “paid” state exists for this lease.
lease.depositAwaiting: Awaiting evidence: no deposit receipt can be evidenced here, so nothing is shown as held.
lease.depositLiability: A deposit is the tenant’s money: never the owner’s income and never part of an owner payout.
lease.documentsHint: References only: the prototype stores no files.
lease.authorityDoc: Owner’s written authority for this letting
lease.versionsHint: A renewal adds a version; earlier versions, and the agreement versions they are bound to, never change.
lease.ledgerPrincipal: Principal model: the owner’s own entity collects into its own account, so the manager keeps no client money or subledger for this lease.
lease.ledgerTitle: Owner subledger in the client money account
lease.ledgerEmpty: No entry: nothing can be settled without bank evidence, and approved demands are not entries.

renew.title: Renew the lease
renew.intro: The renewal starts the day after the current end ({{date}}) as a new version, bound to the agreements in force then.
renew.binding: Earlier versions keep their rent and agreement versions.

terminate.title: End the lease early
terminate.intro: Choose today or a later date before the current end. No rent is scheduled after it.
terminate.deposit: The deposit stays a liability until a refund can be evidenced.

authority.title: Owner’s written authority
authority.intro: The owner’s signed authority for this letting (fictional reference). It is needed before activation.
authority.confirm: I have seen the owner’s signed authority (fictional) for this letting.

refund.title: Deposit refund
refund.partial: A refund can only return a deposit evidenced as held. No deposit receipt has bank evidence here, so nothing can be refunded or instructed.
refund.next: When deposit receipts can be evidenced, a refund will be an approved instruction, settled only by evidence.

wizard.title: New lease
wizard.intro: A lease starts as a draft. A second person activates it once every landlord’s agreement is signed and in force.
wizard.unitHint: Units of your rentals sites only (Riverbend Villas has no rentals licence).
wizard.unitLetWarning: This unit is let under {{ref}} until {{date}}: a new lease must start after that.
wizard.landlordsIntro: The unit’s registered owners. Give each landlord’s share of the rent; together they must make 100 %.
wizard.noAgreement: No management agreement: the manager cannot let this unit on this owner’s behalf.
wizard.unsigned: Agreement {{ref}} is not signed and approved: you can save a draft, but it cannot be activated until it is.
wizard.mixedModels: These owners’ agreements use different issuing models; one lease cannot mix them.
wizard.tenantHint: People on the register with no current lease; current tenants and owners are not offered.
wizard.depositHint: Capped by the agreement (two months’ rent in these fictional agreements).
wizard.depositClient: Held in the client deposit account as the tenant’s money (a liability).
wizard.depositOwner: Held in the owner’s own account as the tenant’s money (a liability).
wizard.payerBody: From {{date}}, {{tenant}} pays the rent on the lease’s own payer account (kind lease), issued under the agreements’ model.
wizard.duesSeparate: The society maintenance dues payer of the unit is separate and does not change.
wizard.authorityLater: You can also record the authority on the lease later; it is needed before activation.
wizard.reviewNote: Saving creates a draft. Nothing is invoiced, collected or paid.
wizard.submitted: Lease {{ref}} saved and submitted for activation

roll.title: Rent roll
roll.intro: Each month’s rent lines from the active leases, previewed by one person and approved by another. An approved roll is a demand, not an invoice.
roll.approved: Rent roll for {{month}} approved as a demand
roll.approveEffect: This approves what tenants owe for the month. It does not invoice anyone, record a payment or move money.
roll.acknowledge: I understand this approves a demand, not invoices or payments.
roll.limited: You see the lines of your rentals sites only. Preparing or approving a roll needs every rentals site.

blocked.other_sites: Preparing or approving a rent roll needs every rentals site.
blocked.own_roll: You previewed this roll, so someone else must approve it.
blocked.stale: Leases changed since the preview: preview again before approval.
blocked.period_not_allowed: A rent roll can be prepared from the month rentals was licensed up to next month.

roll.posting: An approved roll cannot be posted as invoices yet. The shared invoice engine needs, first:

needs.lease_subject: a lease billing subject, so a rent invoice is bound to its lease, period and schedule version;
needs.payer_account: the lease payer account (kind lease) in the shared engine, kept apart from society dues accounts;
needs.numbering: rent invoice numbering for the issuing entity under each agreement model;
needs.idempotent_source: one invoice per lease, period and version, never posted twice.

roll.notPrepared: Not prepared yet: these are the lines a preview would hold.
roll.noLines: No rent falls due in this month
roll.totalHint: A demand total: nothing of it is invoiced, collected or settled.

statements.title: Owner statements
statements.intro: One owner and one month: every line opens its source. The closing payable counts settled money only.
statements.none: No owner has an agreement in force yet
statements.heading: {{name}} · {{month}}
statements.agreement: Agreement {{ref}} version {{n}} · management fee {{fee}} % of settled rent
statements.sample: Sample statement: demo document, fictional data.
statements.issueEffect: The statement is frozen as it stands and the landlord can open it in the resident app. Later changes never rewrite it.
statements.limited: You see the lines of your rentals sites only, with totals over them. Issuing needs every site of this owner.
statements.issuePermission: Only the client money accounts officer issues statements to owners. You can read and print this one; issuing it is for them.
statements.frozen: Issued: this snapshot never changes, whatever happens to the leases later.
statements.settledHint: Opening + settled rent − fees − settled expenses − settled payouts = closing payable. Nothing is settled without bank evidence.
statements.settledPrincipal: Principal model: the owner’s own entity collects, so the manager holds nothing for this owner and owes nothing.
statements.memoHint: Demands, approvals, deposits and instructions are not money received or paid.
statements.noSettled: No settled line: no bank evidence exists here.

state.approved_unpaid: Approved by the owner — not paid

payouts.title: Owner payouts
payouts.intro: Instructions to pay owners from their settled payable: prepared by one person, approved by another, never more than what is left to instruct.
payouts.partial: No outgoing payment can be bound to bank evidence here, so every instruction stays “Not settled — no evidence”. An approved instruction is not sent and not paid, and changes neither cash nor the owner payable.
payouts.limited: Owners with properties outside your rentals sites show no amounts, and their instructions are not listed: acting on them needs every site.
payouts.noOwners: No owner has an agreement in force
payouts.prepareEffect: Someone else approves it. Approved or not, it is never sent or paid here.

hold.no_settled_money: Nothing can be instructed: no rent is settled (no bank evidence exists here).
hold.principal_model: Principal model: the owner’s own entity collects; nothing is held for this owner.
hold.no_collection_authority: The agreement gives no authority to collect on the owner’s behalf.
hold.beneficiary_unverified: The owner’s account is not verified.
hold.other_sites: This owner has properties outside your rentals sites: amounts and actions need every site.

payouts.noInstructionsHint: None can be prepared while nothing is settled.
payouts.approveEffect: Approval means the instruction may later be sent once a payment rail and settlement evidence exist. Nothing is sent or paid now, and the owner payable does not change.
payouts.acknowledge: I understand this approves an instruction, not a payment.

effect.reject: It returns to nobody: a new instruction can be prepared if needed.
effect.cancel: It is kept as cancelled. Nothing was sent or paid.

blocked.own_instruction: You prepared this instruction, so someone else must approve it.
blocked.own_record: You are one of this owner’s own people, so you may not approve it.
blocked.exceeds_available: It is more than what is left to instruct.

needs.client_account: the verified client money account the payout is paid from;
needs.statement_line: a line of a statement imported for that account (in the prototype, a labelled fictional sample);
needs.match: a full match of owner, amount and direction, one line settling one instruction once;
needs.exception: a partial match only through an exception approved by a second person;
needs.reversal: a reversal path that reopens the payable and the instruction.

settings.collectLabel: The owner authorises the manager to collect on their behalf (agent model).
